toni (ml-eng): starting a short smoke thread for customer invoice onboarding. ran a quickpack with LoRA graft + int3 per-channel quant. seeing locale/thin-space and trailing-zero glitches.
ravi (applied-ml): are we grafting to LayerNorm or MLP-only? last time LN graft caused token blending.
toni (ml-eng): initial run was graft=full (MLP+LN) sparsity=0.65, quant=per-channel int3 symmetric. eval command used:
```
python eval_pack.py --model redwood-4x@cust-invoice-lora --dataset cust_invoice_qpack.json --metrics amount_f1,format_exact
```
results snippet:
```
{"amount_f1":"0.939","format_exact":"0.84"}
```
lucy (qa): format_exact 0.84 fails customer SLA. failing examples show "1\u00A0234,00 \u20AC" -> "1234,00\u20AC" (thin-space removed) and "$1,000.00" -> "$1,000" (trailing .00 dropped).
nora (solutions): mitigation options: 1) graft MLP-only, 2) lower sparsity 0.55, 3) per-channel symmetric quant (we already used), 4) token-preserve postprocess for amounts.
toni (ml-eng): building MLP-only sparse=0.55 artifact now, will run 1k quickpack + 1% shadow. uploading when done.
ops-bot: queued canary: env=staging->prod-shadow percent=1 start=2026-03-23T20:00:00Z rollback_on=format_exact<0.95 or amount_f1<0.96
lucy (qa): I'll add CI token_roundtrip checks for NBSP/thin-space (U+00A0, U+202F) and exact decimal regex. will block if failures >0.5%.
toni (ml-eng): uploaded s3://redwood-artifacts/cust/redwood-4x-lora-mlp-s55-int3pc.tar.gz sha256=ff9e2d... re-running eval.
new results:
```
{"amount_f1":"0.968","format_exact":"0.953"}
```
ravi (applied-ml): nice improvement. format_exact 0.953 within canary gate with token-preserve postprocess enabled for first 24h. also want an ablation: graft MLP-only vs graft MLP+cross-attn to see separator-preserve delta.
toni (ml-eng): will run ablation and KV-cache warmstart check for 4k contexts (customer uses long invoice threads). opening follow-up threads for ablation and locale expansion (fr,de,es).
deploy-bot: monitoring assigned to nora, alert format_mismatch_rate>0.03 -> pager.
nora (solutions): will monitor and keep the customer looped in. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
